unit_title: Foundations of High School United States History and Geography

prompts.prompt: Explain historical and geographic inquiry in your own words and give or identify a valid example.
Use a map, data display, timeline, document analysis, or worked process to show understanding of core ideals in founding documents.
Apply change and continuity to 1877 in a new realistic situation. Show the reasoning and cite the evidence.
